market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: After 3 races in 2026 (China, Japan, plus one), Russell sits 2nd in the Drivers' Championship with ~63 pts, 9 pts behind Mercedes teammate Antonelli (72). Mercedes has won all 3 races. With ~19 races remaining and Antonelli in form, Russell has a credible shot but is not the favorite; Antonelli leads and Verstappen/McLaren typically rebound. Probability estimate around 25-30%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: How sustainable Antonelli's pace is and whether other teams catch Mercedes mid-season
